smarters: Open IPTV Smarters and choose “Add user”, then “Login with Xtream Codes API”.
Type any name, then the username and password above.
Enter the server URL exactly as shown, then “Add user”.
tivimate: In TiviMate, choose “Add playlist”, then “Xtream Codes”.
Enter the server URL, then the username and password.
Choose “Next” and wait for the catalogue to load.
ibo: Open IBO Player and note the MAC address and device key it shows.
On the IBO Player website, sign in with them and add an Xtream playlist.
Enter the server URL, username and password there, then restart the app.
xciptv: Open XCIPTV: it asks for the login at the start.
Enter the username and password, then the server URL.
ott_navigator: In OTT Navigator, open Settings, then “Provider”, then “Add provider”.
Choose “Xtream Codes login” and enter the server URL.
Enter the username and password, then save.
smartone: Open SmartOne and note the MAC address it shows.
On the SmartOne website, add a playlist for that MAC address with type Xtream.
Enter the server URL, username and password there, then reload the app.
iptvnator: In IPTVnator, choose “Add playlist”, then “Xtream Code”.
Enter the server URL, username and password.
uhf: On Apple TV, open UHF and add a new source.
Choose Xtream Codes and enter the server URL.
Enter the username and password, then save.
other: In the app, look for “Xtream Codes” or “Login with Xtream”.
Enter the server URL, the username and the password above.
Save, and wait for the movies and series to load.
